turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mrs. Khan of Hyderabad?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is she. Who is calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am Inspector Vikram from the Cyber Crime division. We have intercepted a courier package containing illegal narcotics linked to your Aadhaar card.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: What? This must be a mistake. I have never sent any such package!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That is why we need to conduct a digital arrest to verify your identity. You must stay on this call and not tell anyone, or we will have to send a team to your house immediately.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I am very scared, beta. Please tell me what is happening. Why is my name there?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your documents were used by a syndicate. To clear your name and avoid jail, you must cooperate with our verification process right now.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I don't understand. What do I need to do to fix this?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You need to transfer eighty thousand rupees into our secure government verification account to prove your funds are legitimate.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Eighty thousand? I don't have that much ready in my hand.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: If the payment is not made in one hour, the warrant will be signed and you will be arrested from your home.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Please give me a little time to call my son.
